title: Talented artist H Harry delivers his latest single titled “Preaching”
htmlContent:
Taking over the industry with every enthralling drop is H Hatter, formally known as Harry Elton-Shewan. H Harry is a talented rapper, lyrical genius, and producer from Brighton. H Hatter delivers his latest release at its finest on his new song “Preaching.”

H Hatter, on his latest release, “Preaching,” expresses his lyrical prowess at its finest. The emceeing sound has a signature that keeps you coming back for more. It’s a record packed with talent and substance that makes it enjoyable and a record with unlimited replay value.
